title: Amazon Cargo Plane Overshoots Runway, Closing Miami Airport
description: An Amazon.com Inc. cargo plane overran a runway at Miami International Airport and burst into flames on Sunday, shutting down the airport’s runways and taxiways and prompting an emergency response. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nigeria’s Antitrust Agency Probes Uber’s Exit From Country
description: Nigeria’s antitrust commission said it is probing Uber Technologies Inc.’s abrupt exit from the West African nation, after the ride-hailing platform shut down last week without prior notice to users.
